node_definition.done_when: Done when. tests/test_a_replayed_row_shows_its_transition_time.py attaches a follower to a pipe over a fixture event log holding a transition stamped 09:00:00 UTC on the previous day, and over a fixture store holding a review run, terminal at the attach, whose last transition the fixture event log stamps at 08:00:00 UTC on the previous day. It sets the zone to UTC and attaches at a frozen 12:30:00. The transition's row reads [replay] 09:00:00 and the review's row reads [replay] 08:00:00 ; neither carries 12:30. At the base revision, the same test finds 12:30 on both rows. A second case writes a transition after the attach and finds it printed without the prefix, carrying its own observed time. A third case gives a baseline row a terminal run with no transition in the event log and finds --:--:-- in its clock column. The negative control renders replayed rows with the attach time again, and the test then fails on the first case. The test files importing reckon/crew_follow_commands.py add no failure against the base revision, run on the all_debug partition one arm at a time with at most -n 4 , never on the fleet node. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py , reckon/crew/ticker.py and the new test tests/test_a_replayed_row_shows_its_transition_time.py .
